subject: prd/docgate
statement: When validating an amendment envelope, docgate shall validate against the schema of the envelope's declared template version from the supported set — `amendment-template/v1` (the seven base fields) and `amendment-template/v2` (v1 plus an optional `Tracking` row carrying an issue or PR reference) — and shall fail any envelope declaring a version outside the set or carrying fields unknown to its declared version.
rationale: an amendment whose implementation lands later needs a durable pointer to what tracks that work; version-keyed validation adds it without touching frozen history (#54 A1/C1)
fit_criterion: a v2 fixture with `Tracking` green; a v2 fixture with an unknown field red; a v1 fixture without `Tracking` green (grandfathered forever); a v1 fixture **with** `Tracking` red (unknown to v1); a declared v3 red; the real ledger green
